method: severity = magnitude x persistence x recency. magnitude is the distance past each rule's threshold normalised to that region's own scale; persistence saturates at 24 months; recency decays with a 3-year half-life. Deduplicated to the strongest alert per region. Ranking and filtering only: alert text, thresholds and first_crossed dates are unchanged.
